description: Looks up an Irish company by CRO number in the Companies Registration Office open data. PASSED only if the company status is NORMAL; dissolved, liquidated or unknown companies FAIL. Returns the registered name. Use a CRO company number, not a company name or VAT number. Source uncertainty returns UNAVAILABLE, not a pass. Use check_vat for VIES registration, verify_supplier_payment for claimed-name/identity reconciliation, or decide_supplier_payment for a complete signed invoice decision. No invoice is approved here. Free: 1 attempts per UTC day per IP, shared REST/MCP; failures count. Then 0.01 USDC with explicit approval.

cro_number.description: Irish Companies Registration Office company number as a string. Preserve leading zeros; do not supply a name, VAT number or foreign registry ID.
cro_number.title: Cro Number

request.description: Check an Irish company status (CRO): supply this structured object using the nested schema, not a JSON-encoded string.

name: check_company
